decision.explanation: Both documents provide direct evidence supporting distinct educational institutions attended by Radionova Nataliya Vasilievna. Document d1 states she attended the University of São Paulo in the early 1970s, while document d2 confirms her attendance at the Institute of Biology of the Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv in the 1960s. These are separate, non-contradictory claims referring to different periods in her education. Neither source invalidates the other, and both are explicitly stated in the original context.
